identitySignals: Wikipedia states Radius Recycling, Inc. was formerly Schnitzer Steel Industries and changed its name in 2023; it is headquartered in Portland, Oregon, matching the agenda location 'Portland, OR'

A SPAAT (Student Programming for Athletic and Academic Transitioning) page describes Schnitzer Steel Industries, Inc. running the 'Schnitzer Academy' partnership with McClymonds High School in Oakland, matching OUSD's 'Sponsorship Agreement 2021-2022 - Schnitzer Steel Industries, Inc. – McClymonds High School'
The same SPAAT page says Schnitzer is headquartered in Portland, Oregon and has an Oakland office
research.notes: Agenda name 'Schnitzer Steel Industries, Inc.' is the pre-July-2023 name of Radius Recycling, Inc. (2021-2022 agreement predates the rename). Company was acquired by Toyota Tsusho in 2025; legal entity may have changed. Official site is JavaScript-rendered, so no contact details could be verified; phone, email and address left null. Registry IDs not checked.

profile.summary: A company, formerly named Schnitzer Steel Industries, that recycles scrap metal, end-of-life vehicles and appliances, runs the Pick-n-Pull used auto parts chain, and makes steel products. It is headquartered in Portland, Oregon and has facilities across the United States, Puerto Rico and Canada.

sources.title: Schnitzer Join Forces With SPAAT to Expand Opportunities at McClymonds High School

review.notes: Wikipedia confirms Radius Recycling (Portland, OR) was formerly Schnitzer Steel Industries, renamed July 2023, and the SPAAT page confirms the Schnitzer Academy sponsorship with McClymonds High School in Oakland, matching the OUSD item. Summary is neutral and supported by Wikipedia; the official site rendered no content on fetch, but it is the company's own domain and only the website field depends on it.
